name: Core i7-1360P
memory: DDR5-5200, DDR4-3200, LPDDR5/X-6400, LPDDR4X-4267, dual-channel, up to 96 GB

passmark.mapping_note: CPU: exact entry. GPU: PassMark pools every 'Intel Iris Xe' iGPU (80 and 96 EU, many chips) under one entry; there is no per-SKU entry.

notes: igpu.cu counts the 96 EU as 6 subslices of 16 EU (the Xe-LP equivalent of an Xe-core). base_ghz is the P-core base from TPU (E-core 1.6 GHz). ARK lists no NPU, so npu_tops is 0. launch_date from TPU; ARK says Q1'23. Intel tdp_w: default = Processor Base Power, min = Minimum Assured Power, max = Maximum Turbo Power (PL2); PL2 is not comparable to an AMD cTDP maximum. igpu.tflops_fp32 = shaders x 2 FLOP x vendor max GPU clock (single-issue FMA; RDNA 3 dual-issue is not counted). PassMark scores mix TDPs and host devices; treat them as a rough guide only.

sources.note: Intel ARK: cores, turbo clock, power, Intel 7, memory, Iris Xe 96 EU at 1.50 GHz
CPU Mark, single thread rating and samples
TPU: 2.2 GHz P-core base, 1.6 GHz E-core base
Intel names the 13th Gen P-core Raptor Cove; the E-core is Gracemont, carried over from Alder Lake
